But what looks simple might not be so straightforward. Tint a Car has decades of expertise in offering top-tier window tinting solutions in Australia, including automotive, residential, and commercial applications. Here’s a closer look at DIY versus professional window tinting, helping you make an informed choice for your home.

Understanding DIY House Window Tint Kits

Even the best DIY window tint kits for home generally only include a roll of film and basic application tools. This might sound sufficient, but these kits are designed for small-scale projects, possibly requiring you to purchase additional films or special tools for larger or uniquely shaped windows.

The application process can also be more difficult than you’d imagine as it requires precision to avoid air bubbles and misalignments, which can look unsightly and diminish the longevity and effectiveness of the film.

So opting for a DIY house window tint might seem cheaper at first glance, though when the hidden costs add up professional tinting can be better, more affordable, and easier.
